The Federal Detention Center in Honolulu exists to enforce immigration law—not coddle lawbreakers. While humane conditions matter, the real priority is securing the border and swiftly removing illegal aliens. This facility processes criminal violators under ICE’s lawful mandate, part of Trump’s strategy to restore order after Biden’s border collapse.

Instead of virtue-signaling about detainee treatment, Congress should audit why Hawaii’s prison system relies on federal infrastructure due to its own capacity failures. Every dollar spent housing illegals here should fund deportation flights, not bureaucratic hand-wringing.

America’s safety depends on enforcement, not D.C. theatrics.

The facts behind Hawaii’s federal detention reliance and the true costs of border failure are detailed here: https://t.co/6ClKXA78uT

President Trump’s summit with Putin wasn’t about “kowtowing”—it was about leveraging U.S. strength to force Russia into negotiations while ending endless foreign entanglements. The ceasefire redirects taxpayer dollars from a war without clear resolution to domestic priorities like border security and economic stability.

Real peace requires strategic diplomacy, not perpetual conflict. Ukraine’s sovereignty matters, but so does American leadership that prioritizes verifiable outcomes over performative posturing.

Trump’s approach secures U.S. interests, exposes adversaries like Iran, and stops the globalist drain on our resources. Weak politicians want forever wars—Trump delivers results.
